description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Newtonsoft.Json serialization within Orleans serialization framework, including support for adding JSON serializer with custom settings and type support.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to add Newtonsoft.Json serialization support to Orleans serializer builder.

methods.name: AddNewtonsoftJsonSerializer
methods.description: Adds support for serializing and deserializing values using JsonSerializer with optional custom settings.

methods.name: AddNewtonsoftJsonSerializer
methods.description: Adds support for serializing and deserializing values with custom configuration options for the JSON serializer.

methods.name: AddNewtonsoftJsonSerializer
methods.description: Adds support for serializing and copying specific types using Newtonsoft.Json, with configuration delegates for supported and copyable types.
